text: It was a terrible dental experience. I had two fillings and one wisdom tooth extracted. One of the fillings is now causing sensitivity. I contacted their page to report the problem, and the admin said the dentist would be in on the 21st, which I wasn't available. The admin said they would consult with the dentist and contact me back, but they never did (it felt like they weren't following up at all, even though I had reported the problem). I had to message them again. Even after the repair, the sensitivity persists. Why would I waste money if my teeth are going to get worse after treatment? Am I supposed to live with this sensitivity forever? As for the wisdom tooth extraction, the dentist pried my mouth open, causing a wound (it seemed like they didn't have the right equipment; I overheard the dentist talking to the assistant about needing the necessary tools, but they didn't have any).

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมไอทีธ iTeeth Dental Clinic
text: The doctor is kind, speaks politely, provides excellent service, and is gentle. The assistants are also polite and provide good service. The counter staff are also polite, speak politely, and provide good service. Appointments are scheduled as planned, and there is excellent follow-up, with calls made before every appointment. What I liked most was being able to consult with the doctor and ask anything I was unsure about, and receiving excellent advice. Thank you to all the staff at the clinic. I am very impressed, especially since I had a bad experience at another orthodontic clinic where the assistant was rude and disrespectful, and the counter staff were unfriendly and unfriendly (a terrible experience that made me hesitant to go back to that clinic). Oh, almost forgot, at my previous clinic, my retainer didn't fit properly and caused gum pain. They just told me to wear it without making any adjustments. But here, the doctor made a new retainer on the first day, and it didn't fit properly, so they made one urgently. That shows how much the doctor cares for their patients. There are many other small things I appreciated, but it would take too long to list them all. In short, I highly recommend this clinic. If you have any dental problems or want to take care of your dental health, I highly recommend this place. ❤️

📌Orthodontic treatment via case transfer, special offer 999 THB - 13 free items (1999 THB * 2 months, remaining 1000 THB until the case is finished).
This is for anyone considering this procedure. On the first consultation day, we agreed to transfer the case immediately. It seems they were either in a hurry or the counter staff forgot and didn't let me read the entire contract (without my signature acknowledging receipt 😂). This is very important: if you have an urgent matter or cannot come, you MUST NOT reschedule for more than 30 days (the contract states 60 days from the last treatment). Otherwise, you will lose the entire promotion, incur additional monthly charges, and may not receive your retainer upon completion of the case. The person calling to schedule an appointment didn't mention this at all. However, the doctor and assistants were very kind and accommodating. We were very insistent, and they genuinely forgot to inform us. We were unaware of this 5555.
P.S. I've been receiving dental treatment for over a year now. The doctor is gentle, the wait times are short, the assistants always call to remind me of my appointments, the clinic is beautiful and clean, there's parking, and everyone is very nice. 😘
